prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1104; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a collision at an intersection. Insured vehicle was turning left when it struck the claimant's vehicle, which was proceeding straight through. Claimant reports neck strain and is not represented by counsel. Reviewing police report and scene photos before contacting parties.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant describes stiffness and soreness in the neck since the impact and has scheduled an appointment with their primary care provider. Claimant confirmed no legal representation at this time. Explained the claims process and requested medical records once available.

Entry 3: Insured's statement obtained. Insured states the oncoming vehicle was approaching quickly and the insured misjudged the gap while turning left across the lane. Insured acknowledges responsibility for the turn and has provided dash camera footage, which is under review.

Entry 4: Dash camera footage reviewed. Footage shows the insured's vehicle entering the intersection on a left turn and the claimant's vehicle contacting the front passenger side. Liability appears to rest primarily with the insured. Medical bills and treatment notes requested from claimant, who has agreed to sign a release.

Entry 5: Received treatment notes indicating a diagnosis of cervical strain with a recommendation for physical therapy and follow-up in several weeks. Claimant still unrepresented and has been advised of the right to seek legal advice. Claim remains open pending medical review and evaluation of the injury claim.
